svg.title: Red Blue Yellow
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Primary Peter Freeman 2005 PF0405 photograph: small yellow rectangular canvas, one upright blue bar and one upright red bar with rounded ends. Distinct20.3×25.4cm painting; mounting shadow omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.peterfreemaninc.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly/selected-works?view=multiple-sliders; record freeman:PF0405; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
